title: Parameter-Efficient Distributionally Robust Adaptation of Tabular Foundation Models under Subpopulation Shift
abstract: arXiv:2610.01143v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Despite strong mean accuracy, tabular foundation models (TFMs) can perform poorly on underrepresented groups under subpopulation shift, where group proportions change between training and deployment. We propose DR-TFM, a parameter-efficient distributionally robust adaptation framework that requires no true group annotations. DR-TFM adjusts attention to labeled context examples by fine-tuning an existing query scaling network or adding and training one, while keeping all other parameters fixed. We instantiate the framework with two robust objectives using estimated groups or source conditional distributions derived from training data. For TabPFN-3, adaptation updates only 0.016% of the pretrained model's parameters. Across five tabular benchmarks, DR-TFM achieves substantially higher average worst-group accuracy than pretrained TFMs and the compared robust baselines without true group annotations, while maintaining competitive mean grou

translated_title: 子群体偏移下表格基础模型的参数高效分布鲁棒自适应
translated_abstract: 尽管平均准确率很高，表格基础模型（TFMs）在子群体偏移（即训练与部署阶段群体比例发生变化）的情况下，在代表性不足的群体上表现可能较差。我们提出了DR-TFM，这是一个参数高效的分布鲁棒自适应框架，无需真实的群体标注。DR-TFM通过微调现有的查询缩放网络，或添加并训练一个新的查询缩放网络，来调整对带标签上下文样本的注意力，同时保持所有其他参数固定。我们利用从训练数据中导出的估计群体或源条件分布，通过两个鲁棒目标来实例化该框架。对于TabPFN-3，自适应仅更新预训练模型参数的0.016%。在五个表格基准测试中，DR-TFM在无需真实群体标注的情况下，实现了比预训练TFMs和所比较的鲁棒基线显著更高的平均最差群体准确率，同时保持了有竞争力的平均群体准确率。
tldr: 提出DR-TFM框架，通过仅微调0.016%的参数（查询缩放网络）实现表格基础模型在子群体偏移下的分布鲁棒自适应，无需真实群体标注即可显著提升最差群体准确率。
en_tdlr: DR-TFM is a parameter-efficient distributionally robust adaptation framework for tabular foundation models that fine-tunes only a query scaling network (0.016% of parameters), substantially improving worst-group accuracy under subpopulation shift without requiring true group annotations.
